verdict.rationale: Plugging in MCP servers so the product can use their tools is a capability of an AI agent or LLM host acting as an MCP client. ROS 2 is a robotics middleware and framework (pub/sub, services, actions, DDS) with no agent or LLM host of its own, so the story does not fit its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows ROS 2 shipping MCP client support that would make the axis apply.
